fn CountValidTriplesHelper(k: Int, s: Int, z: Int) -> Int
  requires (k >= 0)
  requires (z >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (z > k) then 0 else (CountValidTriplesForZHelper(k, s, z, 0) + CountValidTriplesHelper(k, s, (z + 1)))))
  effects pure
  example (CountValidTriplesHelper(0, 0, 0) == 1)
  example (CountValidTriplesHelper(0, 0, 1) == 0)
{
  if (z > k) then 0 else (CountValidTriplesForZHelper(k, s, z, 0) + CountValidTriplesHelper(k, s, (z + 1)))
}

fn CountValidTriplesForZHelper(k: Int, s: Int, z: Int, y: Int) -> Int
  requires (k >= 0)
  requires (z >= 0)
  requires (y >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (y > k) then 0 else ((if ((0 <= ((s - y) - z)) and (((s - y) - z) <= k)) then 1 else 0) + CountValidTriplesForZHelper(k, s, z, (y + 1)))))
  effects pure
  example (CountValidTriplesForZHelper(0, 0, 0, 0) == 1)
  example (CountValidTriplesForZHelper(0, 0, 0, 1) == 0)
{
  if (y > k) then 0 else ((if ((0 <= ((s - y) - z)) and (((s - y) - z) <= k)) then 1 else 0) + CountValidTriplesForZHelper(k, s, z, (y + 1)))
}

fn CountTriples(k: Int, s: Int) -> Int
  requires (k >= 0)
  requires (s >= 0)
  requires (s <= (3 * k))
  ensures (result == CountValidTriplesHelper(k, s, 0))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (CountTriples(0, 0) == 0)
